changes_made.explanation: Removed 'BART' (too generic) and simplified output description. Added 'Transformer' model mentioned in implementation details. Normalized ParaLS* notation.
All extracted metrics are correct and properly normalized. These are standard LS evaluation metrics and text generation evaluation metrics used in the paper.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. GPT-3 is only mentioned as a baseline generation model, not for evaluation.

guideline: a word is regarded as acceptable if it is judged to be good by more than five out of ten annotators, and conceivable if selected by at least one annotator

changes_made.explanation: The paper does NOT conduct human evaluations. The extracted guideline describes the annotation criteria used in the SwordS benchmark dataset creation, not human evaluation conducted by the authors. The authors only use existing benchmark datasets with pre-existing annotations.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on lexical substitution using paraphrase models with novel decoding strategies. It uses standard LS benchmarks and automatic metrics for evaluation. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted by the authors. The extraction was generally good, except for the misinterpretation of dataset annotation guidelines as human evaluation conducted in the paper.
